narrative:
The price deck drives the plan: Brent USD 75/bbl in the budget, with the forward curve at USD 71.80 for 2026. Each USD 1/bbl moves revenue by USD 2.1B and operating income by about USD 1.44B after hedge settlements and royalties.

Downstream is the weak link — Asian polymer spreads at USD 280/t sit at a 10-year low and Singapore diesel cracks are softening into Q2. Gas is the bright spot: Al-Rimal phase 2 frees about 240 kbpd of crude from domestic power burn for export.

signals.title: Brent sensitivity: $2.1B revenue per $1/bbl
signals.source: Meridian Corporate Planning — price deck model
signals.excerpt: Every $1/bbl Brent move changes FY2026 revenue by about $2.1B and net income by about $0.9B after the price-linked royalty tier and 46% effective tax.

signals.title: Refining margin squeeze at international JVs
signals.excerpt: International Refining JVs run at 68% cost of sales; a $2/bbl drop in the Singapore complex margin costs about $2B of EBITDA.

signals.title: Gas expansion is the growth engine
signals.source: Meridian Gas Co. — Al-Rimal program review
signals.excerpt: Non-Associated Gas Fields revenue is budgeted 3 points above group growth as the Al-Rimal unconventional program ramps and frees crude for export.
